ui.error.openpyxl:
The openpyxl library, used to write XLSX files, is missing.

Windows (OSGeo4W): run the OSGeo4W installer and add the python3-openpyxl package.
Linux: install the python3-openpyxl package.
macOS: in the QGIS Python console run: import pip; pip.main(['install', 'openpyxl'])
